Hikari-san!

Gggggghhhh...

Nnnghhhhhhh!
Oh no, oh no...
Nnnghhhhhhh!

Nnnghhhhhhh!

Gggggghhhhhhhhh! Gggggghhhhhhhh!

Ggggghhhh... Nnnghh... Ngh―
Is he... okay now?
Hey, look―Doe dropped something.
Hrmm? That's...

Hey, Doe! Answer us, asshole!
Well, there he goes―it's not like he's{SAUT}answered any of our questions{SAUT}to begin with.

Wah! Who're they!?
Well, the TL;DR version is: they're the{SAUT}Blue Brigade.
Ah, you're right, they're quite blue―{PAGE}Wait, what―Why is he popcorn!?

Let's try it out.{OPTION}It's awfully suspicious...{OPTION}It could be a trap.
I agree. If we don't try, we won't make{SAUT}any progress.
I mean, it came out of his body...{SAUT}I'm kinda freaked out too.
But, we have nothing else to go on.{SAUT}I believe it's worth testing.
But, there's nothing else we can try.{SAUT}We're trapped here.
Well then, let us test it at once.
If a decision has been reached, then{SAUT}let us vamoose.
Hey―just who are those people in the{SAUT}blue clothes?
We don't have a clue―but I'll try to{SAUT}fill you in anyways on the way there.
